rule: public_origin remains null until a separately authorized release. Hosting and public address are unselected under audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-16.md, prospectively superseding the 3 October selection. Valid origins are https://<host>, optionally followed by lowercase path segments, without trailing slash, query or fragment. The build supports absolute discovery metadata and base-path portability; tests use reserved fixtures, not a chosen production address.
pre_release_rule: While pre_release is true every page, the root entry and the 404 included, carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> (owner decision B3, 3 October 2026): under a path, crawlers ignore the robots.txt the build writes, so the pages themselves say it. It is set to false at release, after the owner's acceptance (docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md, step 13); the 404 then keeps its own noindex. Checked by scripts/validate.py (RC-NOINDEX). Implementation: scripts/discovery.py.
licence_rule: The reuse licence is decided and the rights question is closed: CC BY 4.0 for the content CauseWay owns in this resource (adopted 3 October 2026, audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-02.md section E and the owner note of about 11:15, 3.6; closed 10 October 2026, audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-10.md, OWN-04-R). This flag decides nothing about that licence. licence_text_confirmed records only that the owner confirms the CC BY 4.0 text that /rights/ and /terms/ print and the footer licence line, in both languages (adversarial verification of the base-path work, 3 October 2026; owner decision of 10 October 2026: the owner confirms it and no counsel review is required). It may be true only while a dated line in audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_*.md records the owner's confirmation (docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md, step 7a); the owner confirmed on 10 October 2026, after RIGHTS-FINAL (audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-10.md section 4). No legal review is claimed. Deployment is disabled under the 16 October 2026 owner decision. Any future release must preserve this confirmed licence state; host and public address remain unselected. Checked by scripts/validate.py (RC-B14). This is the reuse licence (Arabic رخصة), not regulatory licensing (Arabic ترخيص): CauseWay is not a licensed financial institution and claims no such status. The repository's software code is outside this licence and no code licence is decided.
downloads_rule: public_downloads publishes the data exports (scripts/exports.py: CSV and JSON with a bilingual codebook and provenance on every row) under /downloads/. The licence they would carry is decided (CC BY 4.0, licence_rule above); The owner has confirmed the CC BY 4.0 text (licence_text_confirmed, docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md step 7a); public_downloads is a separate owner decision and stays false until the owner switches it on (step 2). scripts/build.py copies build/exports/ into dist/downloads/ only when it is true, and scripts/tests/test_exports.py and the validator fail if a download is in dist/ while it is false. See docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md.
